On a total directed n-cycle the signatures are all length min(d+1,n) words in 3^k colors, yielding the exact sum; strict growth up to n-1 follows from each summand. value.rationale: A naturally motivated modal expressive-power invariant is exactly classified on all finite frames and explicitly evaluated, with its sharp graded depth, for every finite deterministic directed cycle and all finite numbers of letters. The support partition captures genuinely infectious behavior absent from classical modal algebras and provides a reusable finite semantic normal form for formula minimization and classification. It is not a mere numeric tiny gain or a routine single-case recomputation; no extra downstream theorem is claimed.
